product_family: Submagic: AI short-form video editor (captions, Magic clips, AI B-roll, AI avatars, scheduling/publishing, team workspace)

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type I or II)
certifications.proof_quote: No SOC 2 claim found on submagic.co. No trust center or security page exists (https://www.submagic.co/security returns HTTP 404, re-verified 2026-06-27). The privacy policy and terms make no reference to SOC 2.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No ISO 27001 claim found anywhere on the vendor's own domain (home, privacy, terms). No certification page or trust center exists.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable / not claimed. Consumer and business video-editing SaaS with no health-data handling claims.

certifications.name: GDPR (regulatory compliance posture, not a certification)
certifications.proof_quote: "TURBO STUDIO S.A.S. ... acts as the data controller for the Personal Data that is collected via the Website. As a data controller, TURBO STUDIO is responsible for ensuring that the processing of Personal Data complies with applicable data protection law, and specifically with the General Data Protection Regulation." Published sub-processor list, SCCs for EEA transfers, CNIL complaint route, and named DPO (tsifei@submagic.co).

privacy.ai_training_note: Neither the privacy policy nor the terms state that Submagic trains AI models on customer-uploaded content. Users retain content ownership: "You retain all rights to the Content you submit." The granted license is platform-scoped, not a training grant: "by using the Platform, you grant TURBO STUDIO a worldwide, non-exclusive license to use, modify, reproduce, and distribute such Content on and through the Platform." A separate promotional/marketing reuse of customer content is opt-out: "To opt out of TURBO STUDIO using your Content for promotional purposes, send an email to support@submagic.co." No explicit model-training clause was found either affirming or denying training, so default behavior cannot be confirmed.
privacy.data_region: Servers in the United States; sub-processors operate in EU and US. "our servers are located in the United States, and our third-party service providers operate in the EU and the United States." EEA transfers governed by EU Standard Contractual Clauses.

security.name: Dedicated security / trust page
security.value: None. https://www.submagic.co/security returns HTTP 404. No trust center, no responsible-disclosure page found.

security.name: Bug bounty (HackerOne / Bugcrowd)
security.value: None found. No public program on the vendor domain or bounty-platform directories.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Not disclosed. No mention in privacy policy or terms.

security.name: Technical & organizational measures (encryption)
security.value: Generic TOM language only; no specific at-rest/in-transit encryption commitment. "We use appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect the Personal Data ... designed to provide a level of security appropriate to the risk."

security.name: Hosting / infrastructure
security.value: AWS (Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL named as hosting provider in Terms; AWS US/EU as sub-processor), Vercel (edge/app hosting, US), Supabase (auth/database, US/EU). Payments via Stripe.

security.name: Sub-processor transparency
security.value: Full categorized sub-processor list published in privacy policy (AWS, Vercel, Supabase, Stripe, PostHog, Google, TikTok, Customer.io, Crisp, FirstPromoter, Canny, Churnkey) with locations and SCC notes.

security.name: Data subject access / deletion
security.value: Self-serve via in-app "Privacy & data" page (app.submagic.co) for access, export, and EEA/UK account deletion; or by email to david@submagic.co. Named DPO: tsifei@submagic.co.

security.name: Data retention
security.value: Customer data retained no longer than 2 years after contract end (terms cite up to 3 years for account data); accounting data up to 10 years; connection logs 12 months.

products.name: Submagic web app (SaaS)
products.data_scope: User-uploaded video, podcasts, YouTube links; account email and auth (Google/Outlook sign-in); usage analytics. Stored on US servers.
products.notes: Core product. SaaS only, browser-based at app.submagic.co. Free trial available. Account sharing prohibited; 18+ only.

products.name: Team / workspace (business & agencies)
products.data_scope: Same content scope plus multi-user collaboration, brand assets, review/publish workflows.
products.notes: Marketed to media companies, marketing teams, agencies, advertisers. No separate enterprise security/compliance documentation or DPA terms surfaced for this tier.

products.name: Scheduling & multi-channel publishing + YouTube integration
products.data_scope: OAuth access to connected social accounts incl. YouTube channel, video, upload/publishing/scheduling data via YouTube API Services (subject to Google Privacy Policy and YouTube ToS).
products.notes: Users can revoke YouTube/Google access via Google third-party app settings; stored YouTube data deletable on request.

products.name: AI avatars / AI B-roll / AI sound effects / translation
products.data_scope: User content processed through AI generation features.
products.notes: Disclaimer that AI-generated results may not be unique; customer assumes responsibility for AI output. No statement on whether inputs feed model training.

products.name: Free creator tools (and mobile editing)
products.data_scope: Free tools (hashtags, captions, video ideas, thumbnails, hooks, scripts) and phone-footage upload; lighter data footprint.
products.notes: Free creator tools are listed in the site footer and governed by the same privacy policy. A standalone mobile app store listing was not confirmed in the collected evidence; the web app accepts phone footage uploads.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription SaaS (monthly or annual, auto-renewing; free trial). EUR for EU customers, USD for non-EU. Non-refundable except statutory 14-day consumer withdrawal.
compare.data_residency: US servers; EU+US sub-processors; SCCs for EEA transfers. No customer-selectable data region.

flags: No trust center and no security page (vendor /security URL returns 404).
No enterprise certifications (SOC 2 / ISO 27001) and none claimed.
No bug bounty program and no disclosed penetration testing.
AI training on customer content is neither affirmed nor denied; cannot confirm default behavior.
Encryption only described as generic 'technical and organizational measures' with no specific at-rest/in-transit commitment.
Strong, well-documented GDPR posture (named controller, DPO, full sub-processor list, SCCs, self-serve data rights) partially offsets the absence of formal certs.
Minor doc inconsistency: privacy policy says customer data retained no longer than 2 years post-contract; terms cite up to 3 years for account data.
